Accessibility.description_en:
Workspace visibility. Valid values:
PRIVATE: In this workspace, the resource is visible only to you and administrators.
PUBLIC: In this workspace, the resource is visible to all users
Accessibility.description_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见

AutoApproval.description_en: Specifies whether to automatically skip the deployment confirmation step
AutoApproval.description_zh: 是否自动跳过部署确认环节

ConnectionName.description_en: The connection name. This parameter is required when the chat history storage type is RDS
ConnectionName.description_zh: 连接名称。对话历史存储方式为 RDS 的时候需要指定该参数
ConnectionName.title: 连接名称

StorageType.description_en:
The storage method. Valid values:
LOCAL: Chat history is stored in a local SQLite file and does not support multi-instance deployment.
OSS: Chat history is stored in a specific path under the service OSS workspace path.
RDS: Chat history is stored in an RDS table, and an RDS connection must be specified
StorageType.description_zh:
存储方式。取值：
LOCAL: 对话历史保存在本地 SQLite 文件，不支持多实例的部署方式。
OSS：对话历史保存在服务 OSS 工作路径下特定的路径下。
RDS：对话历史保存在 RDS 的表中，需要指定一个 RDS 连接
StorageType.title: 存储类型

EnableInputModeration.description_en: Specifies whether to enable security review for input
EnableInputModeration.description_zh: 是否启用对输入的安全审查
EnableInputModeration.title: 启用输入内容审查

EnableOutputModeration.description_en: Specifies whether to enable content moderation for output
EnableOutputModeration.description_zh: 是否启用对输出的内容审查
EnableOutputModeration.title: 启用输出内容审查

StreamingModerationThreshold.description_en: The cache size for streaming output content submitted for moderation. The default value is 5
StreamingModerationThreshold.description_zh: 流式输出内容送审缓存大小，默认为 5
StreamingModerationThreshold.title: 流式输出内容送审缓存大小

DeploymentConfig.description_en: Deployment configuration. For details, see the deployment configuration (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/user-guide/parameters-of-model-services) in PAI-EAS
DeploymentConfig.description_zh: 部署配置。具体参考 PAI-EAS 的部署配置 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/user-guide/parameters-of-model-services)

DeploymentId.description_en: The ID of the deployment job

StageStatus.description_en:
Status of the deployment stage. Valid values:
NotStarted: Not started.
WaitForConfirm: Waiting for confirmation.
Waiting: Waiting.
Creating: Creating.
Running: Running
StageStatus.description_zh:
部署阶段状态。取值：
NotStarted： 未开始。
WaitForConfirm：等待确认。
Waiting： 等待中。
Creating： 创建中。
Running： 运行中
StageStatus.title: 阶段状态

DeploymentStatus.description_en:
Task status of the deployment. Valid values:
Creating: Creating.
Failed: Deployment failed.
Stopping: Stopping.
Waiting: Waiting.
Starting: Starting.
Running: Running.
Pending: Pending.
WaitForConfirm: Waiting for confirmation.
Canceled: Canceled.
Succeed: Succeeded
DeploymentStatus.description_zh:
部署任务状态。取值：
Creating：创建中。
Failed：部署失败。
Stopping：停止中。
Waiting：等待中。
Starting：启动中。
Running：运行中。
Pending：等待中。
WaitForConfirm: 等待确认。
Canceled：取消。
Succeed：成功

EnableTrace.description_en: Specifies whether to enable Tracing Analysis

OperationType.description_en:
Operation type. Valid values:
Create: Create a new service.
Update: Update an existing service
OperationType.description_zh:
操作类型。取值：
Create： 新建服务。
Update： 更新已有服务

ResourceSnapshotId.description_en: Snapshot ID of the resource to be deployed. If this parameter is provided, the system deploys directly based on this snapshot. If not provided, the system first creates a new snapshot of the resource and then performs the deployment
ResourceSnapshotId.description_zh: 待部署资源的快照 ID。若提供该参数，系统将直接基于该快照进行部署；若未提供，系统会先为资源创建新快照，再执行部署

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of resource to deploy. Valid values:
Flow: A workflow project
Code: A code-based project
ResourceType.description_zh:
待部署的资源类型。取值：
Flow: 工作流的项目
Code: 代码模式的项目

WorkDir.description_en: OSS working directory for the service. It stores operational logs, conversation history, and other data
WorkDir.description_zh: 服务的OSS工作目录。用于存储服务的运行日志、对话历史等

WorkspaceId.description_en: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html）
WorkspaceId.description_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 [ListWorkspaces]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html）

description_en: Retrieve a list of deployment jobs
kebab_example: aliyun pailangstudio list-deployments --workspace-id 478000 --next-token 10 --max-results 20 --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order DESC --deployment-id dploy-asdf0000001234 --resource-type Flow --resource-id flow-asdf000000123 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --creator 26800000004103 --resource-snapshot-id snap-asfg000000123 --service-name myservice01 --deployment-status Creating,Running --operation-type Create --accessibility PRIVATE --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDeployments

parameters.help_en: Workspace ID. For information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html.
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
Pagination cursor used to retrieve the next page of results.  

Leave empty for the first request.  
For subsequent requests, pass the NextToken value returned in the previous response.
parameters.help_zh:
分页游标。用于请求下一页检索的结果。
首次请求时置空。
后续请求时传入上一次响应返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Maximum number of records allowed to be returned in this request.
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求允许返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Field used for sorting in paged queries. The default field is GmtCreateTime. Valid values are as follows:  

GmtCreateTime (default): sort by creation time.  
GmtModifiedTime: sort by updated time.
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时的排序字段，默认使用 GmtCreateTime。取值如下。
GmtCreateTime（默认值）：按创建时间。
GmtModifiedTime：按修改时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
Sorting order.  

ASC: ascending.  
DESC: descending.
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。

ASC：升序。
DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The resource type to be deployed. Valid values:  
Flow: A project of the pipeline pattern  
Code: A project of the Code pattern
parameters.help_zh:
待部署的资源类型。取值：
Flow: 工作流的项目
Code: 代码模式的项目
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resource ID to be deployed.
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query.
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: Number of items displayed per page. Default value is 10.
parameters.help_zh: 每页所显示的项数，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The snapshot ID of the resource to be deployed. If this parameter is provided, the system deploys directly based on this snapshot. If it is not provided, the system first creates a new snapshot for the resource and then executes the deployment.
parameters.help_zh: 待部署资源的快照 ID。若提供该参数，系统将直接基于该快照进行部署；若未提供，系统会先为资源创建新快照，再执行部署
parameters.name: resource_snapshot_id

parameters.help_en: The service name. Fuzzy search by service name is supported.
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。支持按服务名称模糊搜索
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The deployment job status. To query multiple statuses simultaneously, separate them with commas.
parameters.help_zh: 部署任务状态。同时查询多个状态以逗号分隔
parameters.name: deployment_status

The operation type. Valid values:
